question: Which law was formulated in 1662 and concluded that the product of pressure and volume remains almost constant?
solution:
The correct answer is **Boyle's Law**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ​The first reliable measurement on the **properties of gases was made by Anglo-Irish scientist Robert Boyle in 1662.**
 
• The law which he formulated is known as **Boyle’s Law. **
 
• The law says that the **pressure of a fixed amount of gas varies inversely with its volume at constant temperature.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Avogadro’s Law** says that the **equal volumes of all gases** under the same conditions of temperature and pressure contain** equal number of molecules.**
 
• **​Dalton’s Law **says the **total pressure exerted by the mixture of non-reactive gases is equal to the sum of the partial pressure**s of individual gases.
 
• **Charles's Law** for a** fixed mass of a gas** at constant pressure, **volume of a gas increases on increasing temperature and decreases on cooling**
